# Expedia

> > Expedia is a leading online travel booking platform offering flight search, hotel reservations, and vacation packages with One Key membership rewards.

Expedia provides comprehensive travel booking services including partnerships with major airlines like Delta, American Airlines, Southwest, United, Alaska Airlines, and Frontier Airlines. The platform features budget-friendly options, curated deals, and the One Key loyalty program for enhanced savings across flights, hotels, and vacation packages.

## Key Topics

- One Key membership
- Flight deals and cheap flights
- Airline tickets and airfare discounts
- Hotel deals and affordable accommodations
- Major airline partnerships (Delta, American Airlines, Southwest, United, Alaska Airlines, Frontier Airlines)
- Budget travel options
- Popular destinations (San Jose, Las Vegas, San Diego, Long Beach)
- Travel booking and search
- Expedia App
- Vacation packages
- Travel discounts and rewards
- Customer support services

## Flight Booking & Deals

- [Cheap flights, airline tickets & deals - Expedia](https://www.expedia.com/cheap-flights): Main flight search page for booking cheap airline tickets and deals
- [Flight deals on Expedia](https://www.expedia.com/deals/cheap-flights): Curated flight deals and airfare discounts for budget travelers

## Hotel Booking & Accommodations

- [Affordable hotels](https://www.expedia.com/deals/hotel-deals): Hotel deals and budget accommodations with One Key membership benefits

## Support & Assistance

- [Help Center](https://www.expedia.com/helpcenter/): Customer support hub with FAQs and travel assistance resources
